authentication: Existing JWT dependency plus current canonical database identity/activity/role revalidation.
owner: Only immutable authenticated user_id; no authoritative body owner/actor accepted, request extras rejected.
cross_account: ADMIN assisted route only; GENERAL_USER and LIBRARIAN denied. Forged token role does not override current DB role.
retry_receipt: Same UUID/original due/actor replays one extension and one event; stale different UUID cannot apply a second accidental extension, including configured maximum two.
audit: BOOK_RENEWED canonical reader user_id; authenticated actor_user_id; issue/work references; original occurrence timestamp and immutable old/new due snapshots. event_key unique sparse. Failed requests create no success event. Legacy actors remain null.
notifications: Private canonical account inbox; SYSTEM due types only reconciled. Admin messages, other loans and other users remain unchanged.
live_cleanup: Complete; original users/circulation/inventory hashes and book count match.
limitations: Reservation eligibility check is separate from issue CAS; a newly created concurrent reservation is not protected by a cross-collection transaction.

Atomic issue renewal and audit/reconciliation are separate writes; UUID retry repairs side effects. Startup/interval sweep repairs stale notifications; missing audit after a crash requires retry and is not automatically rebuilt.
